attackers_goals: Attackers can attempt to use the command to execute programs or persist malware on remote endpoints.
description: The schtasks.exe command enables creating, deleting, querying, changing, running, and ending scheduled tasks on a local or remote computer. Adversaries may attempt to use the command to execute programs or persist malware on remote machines.
investigative_actions: Investigate the initiator process and whether it should create remote tasks. Investigate the scheduled task execution on the remote machine.
name: Uncommon remote scheduled task creation
